speaker.name: Julian Wood
speaker.title: Principal Developer Advocate for AWS Serverless
speaker.bio: Julian is a Principal Developer Advocate for AWS Serverless. He works within the serverless product teams at AWS to help people use and love serverless more. He also acts as the internal voice of developers and builders to help make AWS serverless the best place to run applications

talk.title: Serverless Compute for Workloads You Didn't Expect
talk.abstract: You write a function, it handles an event. That was the model for AWS Lambda for 10 years. How about taking that same simplicity and applying it to other workloads? Durable workflows, agents, isolated sandboxes, and more. Serverless compute has quietly stretched to cover use cases most developers haven't considered. Learn how to use Lambda to handle even more ambitious workloads.
